reviews.review: Light game with enough dynamics to sink my teeth into!

Perfect fun after work with friends. 

The game keeps introducing more stuff to you as you progress to keep things interesting and make it worthwhile to you to log back in.

10/10 For Karl!

This is a up-to-4-player co-op game that you can also play solo. You're a dwarf working for a mining company that wants to obtain the resources of an alien enviroment. To complete this task, you have 4 classes to choose from. Each class has 3 main weapons, 3 sub weapons, 2 unique tools, and 3 types of throwable weapons.  

The game’s missions are made by a almost random map generator with a enemy spawn system that is also kinda random so it will be quite rare for you to see the exactly same cave with the same exact enemy group again.  

Your gameplay flow will be: Pick a mission from the game's multiple biomes, prepare your dwarf (or dwarves if you're playing with friends) at the base, enter mission, complete a primary and an optional secondary objectives while killing bugs and mining minerals, leave, improve your build if it is possible and now you can pick another mission. You also have weekly special assignments called Deep Dives which are 3-missions-in-a-row challenges that will reward you money, cosmetics and special upgrades to your weapons called Overclocks. They can be repeated but prizes can only be obtained once per week. Also, there's special seasonal missions and weekly assignments to give you more stuff.

It’s a really fun game but i heavily suggest you to buy this only if you plan to play it online with your friends or random people. It's not like you can't play it solo but i'm on the opinion the magic that captivates people in DRG comes from playing online. Not to mention that missions can last from 15 to beyond 60 minutes depending on your skill and repetition will become common after a while.  

By November, 2021 onwards, the devs have also implemented a season system with a free Battle Pass. Each new season will bring a new (and free) Battle Pass filled with cosmetics and a new mission type to play while also bringing new content that can be in the form of enemies, weapons for your characters and/or cosmetics. If you're worried that you'll miss the contents of previous battle passes, you shouldn't be. You are able to obtain any rewards from previous Battle Passes by playing normally in case you couldn't complete them or didn't even have the game at that time. 

Now for the things that bother me:  
[list]
    [*] The whole unlocking system for Overclocks and cosmetics is needlessly stretched out. You can get up to 9 unlocks per week ( 3 random Overclocks, 3 random cosmetics and 3 blank items that you can convert into Overclocks and/or cosmetics through a special event that appears during missions ) which is too low of an amount for a game that has 100+ Overclocks and 300+ Cosmetics to be unlocked. By March 2023 the devs have added the option of getting a Overclock or cosmetic if you promote a dwarf, but i'm on the opinion that this is not enough. The majority of the people will play this game for the online interaction. They don't need padding to keep playing and they just get pissed off because it takes too long to get that sweet Overclock or cosmetic for their favorite class.  

    [*]Both Overclocks and cosmetics have a "pollution" problem that reminds me a lot of Trading Card and Gacha Games. Lots of Overclocks are just cute gimmicks that change the play style of the weapon while bringing so many downsides that the weapon becomes weaker than if it wasn't wearing said Overclocks. On the cosmetic department, we have this nasty design decision that you can't just unlock one specific cosmetic for all classes once, you will unlock one per class and you'll not be able to choose which class will be able to use the cosmetic. 

    [*]This one is the most subjective of my criticisms, but i think it's worth mentioning. The online community is definetly above average and I'm sure you'll have a decent to amazing experience 90% of the time, but beyond the typical minority of ♥♥♥♥♥♥ players there's also Toxic Positivity to be worried about. I myself got kicked out of rooms because of events such as skipping some gold veins, going down more than twice, shooting a Lootbug, shooting a Harvester that was in the way or because i had the Beast Master perk equipped.   
[/list]
I think that’s it... Welcome to DRG and Rock and Stone, miner.
